items.title: 2.10 Predicate logic ka haqeeqi masail par istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of applying predicate logic to real-world problems (PDF 32-33).

blocks.text: Predicate logic ilm ko wazeh aur munazzam pesh kar ke haqeeqi duniya ke masail hal kar sakti hai. Yeh ashya, un ki sifaat aur rishton se bani suraton ka model banati hai, taake hum masail ka tajzia, faisle aur hal mantiqi tareeqe se kar sakein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Predicate logic khandani shajre, social networks aur computer programs tak ka model bana sakti hai.
Rishton ki numaindagi: library ka nizam

items: Borrows(x, y): talib-e-ilm x kitab y leta hai.
Teaches(t, s): ustad t talib-e-ilm s ko parhata hai.
Student(x), Book(y), Available(y), HasLibraryCard(x): ashya ki sifaat.

blocks.text: Aise predicates wazeh batate hain ke talaba, kitabein aur ustad kaise jure hain, is liye library ke kaam ka model banaya aur us ke hisson ke baahami amal ko munazzam aur samjha ja sakta hai.

items: Tamam x ke liye, Student(x) -> Borrows(x, Book): har talib-e-ilm kitab leta hai.
Aisa y maujood hai ke Book(y) AND Available(y): kam az kam aik kitab dastiyab hai.

blocks.title: Pehla qaida durust parhna
blocks.text: Pehle qaide mein 'Book' ka matlab 'koi kitab' hai. Poora likhein to 'har talib-e-ilm kitab leta hai' yeh hai: tamam x ke liye, Student(x) -> (aisa y maujood hai ke Book(y) AND Borrows(x, y)). Teer -> ko 'agar ... to' parhte hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Universal quantifier se 'Tamam talaba ko class mein aana zaroori hai' jaise qawaid likhein.

Predicate logic haqaiq se nataij nikalne deti hai. Agar 'tamam x ke liye, Student(x) -> HasLibraryCard(x)' aur 'Ali talib-e-ilm hai' dono diye hon, to hum nateeja nikalte hain 'Ali ke paas library card hai'. Is qism ka istidlal faislon, jaise yeh jaanchna ke talib-e-ilm kitab le sakta hai ya nahi, mein madad deta aur nataij ko durust aur yaksan rakhta hai taake nizam qabil-e-aitbaar aur sambhalna asan ho.

blocks.prompt: Qaida 'Har dastiyab kitab li ja sakti hai' quantifier se likhein, aur dastiyab kitab B7 ke baare mein faisla karein.
blocks.explanation: Tamam y ke liye, (Book(y) AND Available(y)) -> CanBorrow(y). Kyunke Book(B7) aur Available(B7) sach hain, CanBorrow(B7) nikalta hai: B7 li ja sakti hai.

items: Predicates haqeeqi ashya aur rishton ka model, jaise Borrows(x, y).
Quantifier wale qawaid aam shartein; haqaiq aur qawaid se nataij.
Misal: har talib-e-ilm ka card, Ali talib-e-ilm, is liye Ali ka card.
